Atomix GGUF txt2img 工作流程

特点

  • 在提示符中调用 Lora 而不是 Node。

  • 图像生成数据包含使用模型、Lora、嵌入信息。

  • 自动调整高档瓷砖的尺寸并提供多种宽高比预设。

  • 与UltimateUpscale集成，可以切换不同型号进行升级。

  • 与FaceDetailer集成，可以为FaceDetailer切换不同的模型。

  • 显示每个节点消耗的时间并与之前的执行进行比较。

  • 显示比较之前/之后的 FaceDetailer。

如何使用

1.这是一个ComfyUI工作流程，仅适用于ComfyUI，因此请确保您的ComfyUI可用。https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI

2.将zip文件中的JSON或PNG文件拖至ComfyUI界面。如果一切顺利，工作流程就可以开始了。

3.在步骤2中，可能会出现缺少节点的警报，需要安装这些节点。如果您不想手动安装它们，则必须安装 ComfyUI 插件：ComfyUI Managerhttps://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager安装此插件后，其管理界面中有缺失节点的自动安装功能。

Atomix GGUF txt2img workflow

Feature

  • Calling Lora in the prompt instead of node.

  • The image generation data contain the using model,Lora,embedding information.

  • Automatically adjust the size of the upscale tile and provide multiple aspect ratio presets.

  • Integrated with UltimateUpscale and able to switch different models for upscaling.

  • Integrated with FaceDetailer and able to switch different models for FaceDetailer.

  • Showing the time consumed by each node and compare it with the previous execution.

  • Showing FaceDetailer before/after comparison.

How To Use

1.This is a ComfyUI workflow,only for ComfyUI,so make sure that you ComfyUI is available.https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI

2.Drag the JSON or PNG files from the zip file to the ComfyUI interface. If everything goes well, the workflow is ready to go.

3.In the step2, there may be a alert for missing nodes, and you need to install these nodes. If you do not want to manually install them, there is a ComfyUI plugin that you must have: ComfyUI Managerhttps://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-ManagerAfter installing this plugin, there is an automatic installation function for missing nodes in its management interface.
